svg.title: The actual public-domain Engels portrait of Max Stirner sits inside Lorc’s wax-seal frame; the source crown was removed rather than implying royalty.
svg.desc: Lorc (wax frame) and Friedrich Engels (1892 Max Stirner memory sketch) · CC BY3.0 wax-frame adaptation; public-domain historical portrait · https://game-icons.net/1x1/lorc/wax-seal.html · https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ · Lorc · CC BY3.0 · https://game-icons.net/1x1/lorc/wax-seal.html · Friedrich Engels · Public domain; historical drawing first published1898 · https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Friedrich_Engels_-_Max_Stirner_(1892)_V02-1.2_raw.jpg
